title: helenium autumnale var. pumilum
intro: Helenium autumnale var. pumilum, commonly known as Dwarf Sneezeweed, is a low-growing perennial plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Sneezeweed include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in relieving coughs, congestion, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
